title: Choose the visual world
question: Choose a direction for Protocolo Lupita’s citizen homepage and government console. The supplied shield and your navy, warm off-white, and gold palette stay fixed.

options.label: Puente de señales
options.lineage: VU meter bridges on an audio recording desk
options.thesis: Read each signal as a labeled channel; keep its state beside the evidence, not as an accusation.
options.viewport: Off-white citizen homepage with the supplied shield in a navy header; the existing citizen question and next-step actions on the left; three quiet meter channels for SMS, calls, and reports on the right, each labeled as synthetic demonstration content.
options.risk: Meter language can feel technical or imply live certainty; use no fabricated counts and label every illustrative state.

raised.raise: Keep list and map cross-references explicit, so each channel keeps a stable label wherever it appears.
Make state changes legible through clear contrast; resting states remain still.
Use the supplied shield as the product’s protective outline, unchanged and as a real asset.
Show signal relationships as labeled, inspectable paths.

options.label: Wayfinding de servicio
options.lineage: Civic wayfinding signs and service directories
options.thesis: Treat every safe next step as a clearly marked route through the public service.
options.viewport: A public-service header leads into the existing citizen question; a legible route diagram points directly to SMS review, citizen report, and public alerts, with a separate government entrance.
options.risk: Wayfinding can read as a generic municipal portal unless the signal-to-copy mechanism stays visible.

options.label: Billetera de trayectos
options.thesis: Present citizen actions as a sequence of paper stubs.
options.viewport: A stub sequence links SMS review, reporting, and public advice.
options.case: The journey reads clearly, but the prototype has no persistent citizen ticket or journey status.
options.risk: The travel form would promise saved progress that does not exist.
options.kept: Keep next-step cues explicit without implying saved progress.

options.label: Catálogo de señales
options.lineage: Dense convention catalogs and keyed floor maps
options.thesis: Index reports and zones as a compact grid tied to a map.
options.viewport: A dense map and signal grid dominate the public homepage.
options.case: The map relationship suits analysis, but the citizen’s immediate task disappears inside the grid.
options.risk: Dense catalog navigation obscures plain-language actions.
options.kept: Maintain explicit links between map entries and their labels.

options.label: Estela de señales
options.thesis: Let a trace of light reveal where activity has passed.
options.viewport: An animated dark field becomes the main signal visualization.
options.case: A luminous wake obscures the next action and can make illustrative activity seem live.
options.risk: Glow and fading trails weaken text clarity and overstate the evidence.
options.kept: Use unmistakable active and resting states, still and legible by default.

options.label: Contorno protector
options.lineage: A drawcord cape that gathers into a protective form
options.thesis: Use a transforming silhouette to express protection.
options.viewport: A large fabric form occupies the citizen hero.
options.case: The textile metaphor competes with the supplied fox shield and says little about reviewing signals.
options.risk: A second invented protection symbol would dilute the real logo.
options.kept: Use the supplied shield unchanged as the sole brand emblem.

options.label: Corriente de tinta
options.thesis: Represent correlation as currents that gather into visible patterns.
options.viewport: An animated ink basin becomes the first screen’s dominant visual.
options.case: Fluid patterns do not map to an actual quantitative signal or specific action in the prototype.
options.risk: Decorative flow could imply stronger evidence than the prototype establishes.
options.kept: Show relationships as fixed, labeled, inspectable connections.

canonCard.label: La página estándar de ciberseguridad
canonCard.thesis: Una portada institucional de seguridad, ejecutada con claridad y oficio.
canonCard.viewport: Navegación institucional sobre un hero azul marino con titular y acción a la izquierda, vista del producto a la derecha y funciones debajo.
canonCard.risk: Es familiar y fácil de entender, con menos identidad propia.
